description: List the campaigns that hired the caller's organization by a signed hire, newest signature first, as the web app's Hired On view shows them: each one's hireId, campaignId, campaignName, hiringOrganizationName, signedAt, the signed contract (compensationCents, deliverable, platforms, and creatorPostingDate when set) or null, and payout, which is null until Starcovery records the payout and then holds amountCents, paidAt (null while it is not paid), and shortfallReason when a paid payout fell short. Needs a credential.
name: list_hired_campaigns
title: List hired campaigns
